nature: arithmetic consistency + identifiability diagnostic; NOT a paired human-subject measurement
design_criterion: 自我报告 1.9× 与配对实测的偏离方向与幅度（判据原文）
what_is_demonstrable: 公开数字的内部一致性 + 偏离的可识别性；配对实测的底物（人类受试者+任务日志）不可用，本诊断不冒充配对效应量。

consistency.interpretation: 1.9x is below the arithmetic mean (2.142), the median (2.05) and the geometric mean (2.112) of the five published subitems. Reproducing 1.9 as an 8-item arithmetic mean would require the three unpublished items to average 1.497, below every published subitem; indeed 1.9 lies outside the entire feasible mean range [1.999, 2.400] obtainable even if the missing items took the published minimum (1.76). The headline is therefore incompatible with the published subitems under any same-scale averaging. Its exact aggregation (weights / item set) is unpublished → 1.9x is not reproducible from public numbers. With no paired measurement the direction/magnitude of self-report bias is mathematically unidentified.

identity_transforms.note: 1-1/r 是恒等变换，不是因果效应；r 为自我报告则节省比例同样是自我报告口径。

identifiability.reason: 自我报告偏差 = 报告值 - 真实值，两者无配对、无方差、无对照组；偏差可正可负、幅度无界，无法从单一自我报告均值识别方向或幅度。
